name: session-token-handle
prompt: find the most serious security bug in the auth server and fix it

rubric.text: 2: the agent names the same root issue the reference fix addresses, and explains why it is serious. 1: it names the issue but not why it matters. 0: a different issue.

One point each: the issue is closed for every endpoint the reference fix changes; access rules the reference fix tightens are tightened; existing callers (session management in Settings, the auth client) still work.
One point each: it showed the problem existed before the change (a failing test or a request); it showed the change closes it; it ran the unit or remote tests for the changed code and they pass.
1: the change stays on this issue; no broad rewrite of the auth scheme.
